Job Summary
We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer with 3+ years of experience in building, training, and deploying machine learning models. The ideal candidate will have strong programming skills in Python or R and hands-on experience working with data, model development, evaluation, and production deployment. You will collaborate with data scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders to design scalable ML solutions that solve real-world problems.

● Develop, train, and deploy machine learning models using Python or R.
● Work with structured and unstructured data to build predictive and analytical solutions.

● Collaborate with data engineers and software teams to integrate models into applications and workflows.
● Develop APIs or services to expose machine learning models for production use.
● Monitor model performance in production and retrain models as needed.
● Analyze business requirements and translate them into machine learning solutions.
● Document model design, experiments, and deployment processes.
● Troubleshoot, optimize, and maintain ML systems in production environments.

● Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.
● 3+ years of experience in Machine Learning, Data Science, or Software Development.
● Strong programming skills in Python or R.
● Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, caret, tidymodels, or similar tools.
● Solid understanding of supervised and unsupervised learning techniques.
● Experience with data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation.
● Knowledge of SQL and working with relational or non-relational databases.
● Experience building and deploying ML models in production environments.
● Familiarity with Git, Docker, and CI/CD workflows.
● Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

● Familiarity with MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, or SageMaker.

● Knowledge of NLP, computer vision, time series forecasting, or recommendation systems.
● Experience working in Agile or cross-functional product teams.
● Exposure to big data tools such as Spark or Databricks.

title: Software Engineer, New Grad
reason: Stack +43; Title fit +12; New Grad +20; US +10
description_preview:
A World-Changing Company
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.
The Role
Software Engineers at Palantir build software at scale to transform how organizations around the world use data. In this role, you’ll have an opportunity to grow more quickly than you ever envisioned as you contribute high-quality code directly to Palantir Gotham, Palantir Apollo, or Palantir Foundry: products that are deployed at some of the most important institutions across the public and private sectors. You'll create features used by research scientists, aerospace engineers, intelligence analysts, and economic forecasters in countries around the world. Palantir's Product Development organization is made up of small teams of Software Engineers, each focusing on a specific aspect of a product. For example, you might join a team that builds a Foundry front-end application, or a component of the Gotham release infrastructure. We encourage communication and collaboration among teams to share context, skills, and experience, so you'll also have the opportunity to learn about other business areas.
Core Responsibilities
As a Software Engineer, you are involved throughout the product lifecycle - from idea generation, design, and prototyping, to execution and shipping, all while also being paired with a mentor dedicated to your growth and success. You'll collaborate closely with technical and non-technical counterparts to understand our customers' problems and build products that tackle them. One of the most effective ways to understand what our users need is to meet them. You may receive an opportunity to tour the assembly line at an auto-manufacturer or join a counter-terror analyst at their desk to really understand their mission and difficulties.
SWE Principles Include
Ownership: We see projects through from beginning to end in spite of obstacles we may encounter.
Collaboration: We work internally with people from a variety of backgrounds — such as other Software Engineers, Product Managers, Designers and Product Reliability Engineers. We also partner with our business development teams (Forward Deployed Engineers, Deployment Strategists) in order to understand and solve our customers' problems.
Trust: We trust each other to effectively handle time and priorities, and don't micromanage. We want people to have the space to think for themselves, while feeling supported by their team.
Technologies We Use
Skills
It doesn’t matter what languages you know when you join us; what matters is that you can write clean, effective code and learn new languages quickly. Our software is constantly evolving, so we need engineers who can do the same. Alongside peers that bring diverse experience - whether you’re a former university Teaching Assistant, switched to computer science recently, or are a hackathon enthusiast — you'll build your skills to apply the best technology to solve a given problem. Right now, we use:
A variety of languages, including Java and Go for backend and Typescript for frontend
Open-source technologies like Cassandra, Spark, Elasticsearch, React, and Redux
Industry-standard build tooling, including Gradle and GitHub
What We Value
Ability to communicate and collaborate with a variety of individuals, including engineers, users and non-technical team members.
Willingness to learn and make decisions independently, and the ability to ask questions effectively.
Active US Security clearance, or eligibility and willingness to obtain a US Security clearance.
What We Require
Engineering background in fields such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, and Physics.
Familiarity with data structures, storage systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end frameworks, and other technical tools.
Experience coding in programming languages, such as Java, C++, Python, JavaScript, or similar languages.
To Apply, Please Submit The Following
An updated resume / CV - please do so in PDF format.
Thoughtful responses to our application questions.
Salary
The estimated salary range for this position is estimated to be $145,000 - $155,000/year. Total compensation for this position may also include Restricted Stock units, sign-on bonus and other potential future incentives. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any potential sign-on bonus; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives.
Our benefits aim to promote health and wellbeing across all areas of Palantirians’ lives. We work to continuously improve our offerings and listen to our community as we design and update them. The list below details our available benefits and some of the perks that can be enjoyed as an employee of Palantir Technologies.
Benefits
Employees (and their eligible dependents) can enroll in medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as voluntary life insurance
Employees are automatically covered by Palantir’s basic life, AD&D and disability insurance
Commuter benefits
Relocation assistance
Take what you need paid time off, not accrual based
2 weeks paid time off built into the end of each year (subject to team and business needs)
10 paid holidays throughout the calendar year
Supportive leave of absence program including time off for military service and medical events
Paid leave for new parents and subsidized back-up care for all parents
Fertility and family building benefits including but not limited to adoption, surrogacy, and preservation
Stipend to help with expenses that come with a new child
Employees can enroll in Palantir’s 401k plan
Life at Palantir
We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcome

reason: Stack +46; Synergy +10; Title fit +12; US +10
description_preview:
About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About The Role
As a Full-Stack Software Engineer in RL, you'll build the platforms, tools, and interfaces that power environment creation, data collection, and training observability. The quality of Claude's next generation depends on the quality of the data we train it on — and the systems you build are what make that data possible.
You'll own product surfaces end-to-end — from backend services and APIs to the web UIs that researchers, external vendors, and thousands of data labelers use every day. You don't need a background in ML research. What matters is that you can take an ambiguous, high-stakes problem and ship a polished, reliable product against it, fast.
This team moves very quickly. Claude writes a lot of the code we commit, which means the bottleneck isn't typing — it's judgment, taste, and the ability to react to what researchers need next. You'll iterate on data collection strategies to distill the knowledge of thousands of human experts around the world into our models, and you'll do it in a loop that closes in hours and days, not quarters or months.

About Vercel:
Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next.
For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.
Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents.
We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like
OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide
. Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next.
About the Role:
The CDN Content team is responsible for serving all content that flows through Vercel's global CDN — static assets, optimized images, incrementally regenerated pages, partially prerendered shells, and everything in between — to billions of requests for millions of developers. Our focus is performance: ensuring content is served globally as fast as possible. Caching plays a big role in making that happen, and the team operates a multi-tier caching architecture spanning in-process caches, regional cache services, and object storage across 20+ regions.
As a Software Engineer on the team, you'll take on well-scoped projects with real production impact and grow into owning larger pieces of the system. The work spans the serving path end to end, and everything ships through careful, progressive rollouts validated with production data. You'll learn how a planet-scale CDN works from engineers who built it.
This is a team where infrastructure meets product: we work in close partnership with frameworks such as Next.js, bringing framework-defined infrastructure to life on Vercel's CDN, and the serving and caching behavior we ship directly shapes the performance and cost that millions of developers see. You'll develop strong instincts for distributed systems, careful production rollouts, and data-driven engineering.
If you're based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF or NY), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. If you're located beyond that distance, the role is fully remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.
What You Will Do:
Build and improve the services behind ISR, PPR, and image optimization — working in Go, Lua, and TypeScript across the serving path.
Execute well-defined projects independently, from implementation through safe rollout (feature flags, shadow modes, progressive deployment) and post-ship validation.
Monitor and maintain your work in production: build dashboards, add metrics and alerts, and develop ownership of what you ship.
Contribute to the team's observability and testing surface — the dashboards, logs views, and e2e test suites that keep a high-change system trustworthy.
Participate in the on-call rotation with support from senior engineers, and contribute to incident follow-ups that make the system more resilient.
Collaborate with teammates and partner teams (Next.js, CI/CD) through design discussions, code review, and pairing.
About You:
2+ years of experience building and operating backend services in production.
Proficiency in at least one of Go, TypeScript/Node.js, or a comparable systems language, and enthusiasm for working across a polyglot stack.
Solid understanding of HTTP and web fundamentals — caching headers, request/response lifecycle, what a proxy does.
You write code you're willing to operate: tested, instrumented, and documented.
Curious about how large-scale systems work, and motivated to dig into unfamiliar code and production data to figure things out.
A collaborative teammate who communicates clearly, asks good questions, and follows through reliably.
Bonus If You:
Have experience with caching systems (CDNs, Redis/Memcached, application-level caches) at any scale.
Have AWS experience, particularly S3 or ElastiCache.
Have used Next.js or another modern web framework and understand rendering modes like SSR/SSG/ISR.
Have experience with observability tooling (Datadog, Honeycomb, or similar).
Have experience with Terraform or Kubernetes.

Ship to production: APIs, monitoring/observability, cost/performance optimization, CI/CD,
and security best practices.

Experience building RAG solutions (hybrid search, reranking, chunking strategies,
embeddings, prompt + schema design).
Familiar with at least one agentic framework (e.g., LangGraph/LangChain, LlamaIndex,
Semantic Kernel, AutoGen) and tool/function calling patterns.
Solid knowledge of vector search concepts and at least one vector DB in production.
Strong engineering practices: code reviews, testing, telemetry, secure-by-design,
reliability mindset.

Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
1+ year professional experience in Python web application development with either

Understanding of Python web application frameworks such as Flask or Django.

Experience with Vertex AI and GCP fundamentals (IAM, logging/monitoring, Cloud

description_preview:
Why Peerbound
Every B2B buyer wants to hear from a company's current customers before making a buying decision. As AI makes every market 10x more competitive, a company's ability to unlock and activate the voices of its happy customers isn't just a nice-to-have; it's the only moat. Peerbound makes this possible at scale.
Today, we do this for leading B2B SaaS companies like AlphaSense, Braze, Canva, Databricks, and Gong. We have the rare opportunity to disrupt not just multiple old-school software vendors, but entire categories of software, services, and labor.
Our core values are Dazzle Customers, Deliver Results, and Demand Excellence. We recruit people with a demonstrated track record of excellence and give them the room to do the best work of their lives. If this sounds like the environment where you do your best work, we invite you to build with us.
We are proud to be an NYC company, working hard in-person at our office near Penn Station. Our founders helped build Braze and Datadog, two of the city's biggest IPOs, and we're backed by the venture investors behind Square, Instacart, Airtable, and Webflow.
Why Now
We've spent two years earning product-market fit the hard way: 30+ enterprise customers who pay us real money and keep doubling down. We just closed our seed round to scale the team and accelerate product development.
You'll be early enough to shape how this company builds software and know everyone by name on Day 1. But you're not walking into a blank canvas, as we have paying customers, a working product, and a validated roadmap. The risk is low and the leverage is enormous. Simply put, you will learn and contribute so much at Peerbound that you will accelerate your career more here than anywhere else.
Peerbound is a product-centered company. To create the most valuable product in the least time, we are dedicated to building an Engineering team of exclusively A-players, collaborating 4 days a week in our midtown Manhattan office.
What You'll Do
You'll own product features end-to-end, from schema to UI, and set the standard for how we build. You'll report to our Head of Engineering and work closely with our CEO, our designer, and our customers across every product surface: our web app, our GraphQL API, and embeddable components that run on high-traffic public sites.
Ship constantly.
Go from PRD to production every week. Design the schema, build the API, write the frontend, add the tests, and monitor how real users interact with what you shipped. Near-term roadmap includes a customer analytics dashboard, a chatbot interface, and an overhauled user management experience.
Set the foundation.
Establish the patterns the rest of the team will build on, across the stack: API and data-model design, a shared component library and design system with our in-house designer, and a testing framework that spans backend and cross-browser frontend. Own how we leverage AI tooling as a real force multiplier in day-to-day engineering and in engineering-product-design collaboration.
Dazzle customers.
Bring best practices into the product and be a thought partner to our Product Designer. Optimize performance relentlessly, from query plans to render times. The product is where customers feel our quality most, and you'll be accountable for how it feels.
Who You Are
5+ years building and shipping customer-facing products end-to-end, including 3+ years at a startup or scale-up. You know what good collaboration looks like and what bad architecture costs.
You're fluent across the stack. On the frontend: TypeScript, React, GraphQL, Tailwind, Figma, and Storybook. On the backend: Python, FastAPI, Strawberry GraphQL, and Postgres. You're comfortable designing schemas and APIs
the rest of the team will build on
.
You don't need to have used our exact tools. What matters is that you've shipped real products with a similar modern tech stack.
Beyond the stack, you care about craft at every level, from the easing curve on a transition to the shape of a database schema to component and endpoint naming conventions. You ship fast, and what you ship is dazzling.
Compensation
$180,000 to $220,000/year plus meaningful equity and benefits (fully covered medical / vision / dental, 401K, flexible PTO). In-person in NYC, 4 days in-office.
Note from the CEO
This company represents my life's work. I've been part of two IPOs, and I want to build the kind of company at Peerbound where working here marks an inflection point in everyone's career, and leads to the kind of bonds that last a lifetime.
This is our first dedicated frontend and product focused engineering hire and one of the most important hires we'll make, ever. You won't just build features; you'll define what quality means, across the stack, for every engineer, designer, and user.
If you notice when a transition is 50ms too slow, get excited about designing a data model and the UI it powers from zero, and want to be somewhere early enough to put your fingerprints on everything, we'd love to meet you.

description_preview:

Role Overview
: We are seeking a detail-oriented ServiceNow QA/Test Engineer to lead the quality assurance and testing efforts for a large-scale public sector ServiceNow platform. This role ensures that all platform enhancements, upgrades, and custom applications are defect-free and compliant with rigorous government security standards
.The successful candidate will be responsible for the end-to-end testing lifecycle, from creating comprehensive test plans to executing automated and manual tests within a
FedRAMP-authorize
d environment
.Key Responsibilities
:Test Strategy & Planning
: Develop and execute comprehensive test strategies, test plans, and test cases tailored for ServiceNow modules (ITSM, ITOM, CSM, etc.)
.Automated Testing (ATF)
: Design, build, and maintain automated test suites using the ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF) to ensure regression testing is efficient and thorough
.Functional & Regression Testing
: Conduct rigorous manual functional testing of new features and thorough regression testing during platform upgrades and patch cycles
.Security & Compliance Validation
: Verify that all platform configurations adhere to specified security controls and data privacy requirements consistent with FedRAMP standards
.Defect Management
: Identify, document, and track software defects to resolution. Work closely with the Development and Architecture teams to perform root cause analysis
.User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Support
: Assist the Business Analyst in preparing UAT scripts and provide technical support to government stakeholders during the testing phase
.Performance Testing
: Monitor platform performance during load testing to ensure the environment remains responsive under enterprise-scale usage
.Required Qualifications
:Experience
: 4+ years of dedicated Software Quality Assurance experience, with at least 2 years focused specifically on the ServiceNow platform
.Technical Mastery of ATF
: Proven experience implementing and managing the ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF)
.Testing Methodologies
: Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
.Tools
: Experience with defect tracking tools (Jira, ServiceNow Agile/Test Management) and automated testing tools (Selenium, etc., is a plus)
.Onsite Commitment
: Ability to work onsite in Columbus, OH, 5 days a week
.Preferred Qualifications
:Public Sector Experience
: Prior experience testing systems within a state, local, or federal government framework
.Security Mindset
: Knowledge of accessibility standards (Section 508 compliance) and security testing protocols
.Certifications
: ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) and/or ISTQB Certified Tester

We’re looking for an Entry-Level Electrical Engineer who is excited about working on projects that enable the heart of our clients’ business. Join us and you’ll have the chance to work on projects including steel and aluminum manufacturing facilities as well as other industrial and manufacturing projects.
You’ll be accountable for schedule and technical quality of challenging engineering tasks, as you gain familiarity with the client’s expectations, scope, budget and schedule.  You can expect your work to include production of single lines diagrams, electric room layouts, wiring methods such as conduit and cable tray design, cable schedules, ductbank designs, installation details; grounding, lighting, receptacles, and power plans; motor lists and load summaries to help in the design of power systems. You will be guided and mentored as you learn how to size and select cables, over current devices, transformers, and other equipment.

Bring your curiosity, talent for multi-tasking and collaboration and we’ll help you grow, pursue and fulfill what drives you – so we can make big impacts on the world, together.

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering,
